output.answer: As of November 11, 2026, CleanSpark (NASDAQ: CLSK) had 78,727,139 shares sold short—about 78.73 million shares—equal to 31.93% of its float, with 4.57 days to cover (latest settlement date: October 30, 2026). This is the latest reported figure available today; FINRA's schedule lists November 13 as the next settlement date, with publication scheduled for November 24, 2026.
caveats: Short interest is reported twice monthly by settlement date, not continuously; therefore the October 30 figure is not a real-time position as of November 11.

Some data vendors show a different percentage of float (for example, MarketBeat reports 31.31%) because float/share-count conventions differ, although the reported short-share count is the same 78,727,139 shares.
